newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CROWN SEEN STEADY IN QUIET MARKET ACTIVITY.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CROWN SEEN STEADY IN QUIET MARKET ACTIVITY.

text.p: 0830 GMT - Slovak crown hovers at around -0.45 percent on
the depreciation side of its mark/dollar basket parity in quiet
Wednesday morning trading, with dealers predicting it to hold
at current levels throughout the day.
*Crown trades at 34.844/34.894 bid/offer to the dollar and
at 18.794/18.834 bid/offer to the mark since market open.
*Dealers say the crown so far shows no reaction to
Tuesday's annoucement that the government plans to issue
crown-denominated bonds on foreign markets in the fourth
*"Trading is very quiet at the moment, without any stronger
trend. The crown should hover at around -0.50 percent later
today unless there is a larger client order which could move
the market," said Dusan Svitek of Slovenska Sporitelna.
mark 18.760, deviation against the basket -0.35 percent.
